title.narrative: Low carbon industrial development in Tamil Nadu, India - Roadmap for Green Business Forum and Green Indexing

description.narrative: The project aims to motivate businesses in Tamil Nadu to take up low-carbon commitments and action to advance the state government’s Climate Change ambitions while contributing to national targets. To achieve this, the project will establish a Green Business Forum and establish and subsequently a Green Indexing Mechanism for rating of industries in Tamil Nadu.
